validation_boundary: Atoms were validated against a strict local Pydantic contract reconstructed from recent validated project LiteratureAtom artifacts and the large-source guideline guardrail. Because the governing ATOM model/schema files were not directly retrievable, this report does not claim execution of the authoritative project Pydantic/schema code.

duplicate_review.finding: All atom_id values are unique. Recommendation and Practice Point identifiers are kept in separate namespaces where numbering overlaps.

consistency_review.finding: Recommendation strength and certainty are preserved in tags, Practice Points remain ungraded, and secondary evidence summaries were not promoted to primary-study results.

schema_gaps: The recent project LiteratureAtom model has no dedicated guideline_recommendation or practice_point atom kind. Formal guidance is serialized as atom_kind="other" with descriptive tags.

The authoritative ATOM validation source files and SEA v4 protocol were not directly retrievable in this session, so validation and SEA structure use the current large-source skill plus recent validated project artifacts as the recoverable local contract.
extraction_limitations: Several PDF text-layer strings contain ligature or line-wrap artifacts; canonical statements were normalized against rendered page images and source meaning.
The ATOM schema is oriented toward primary literature. This extraction captures KDIGO's own guidance and methods, not the underlying trials as if KDIGO enrolled participants.
All atoms remain needs_review because no human reviewer verified them.
The data supplement was used for SEA evidence reconciliation and its reference index; individual evidence rows were not atomized as primary results.
